answer: Each epoch auctions 100 seats by sealed bid. A beacon opens bidding; each applicant stakes 70 credits on one quartz-sealed bid, onyx-stamped to its key. Winners pay the clearing price; losers reclaim. First fake costs 40, kth 40+3(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 1,538,500 against at most 40,000 rewards. A rented-bid ring fails: a shared stamp burns both bonds, and the beacon names winners. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its slot.
